text: [AA] A psalm of the Korahites. A song. I His foundation is on holy mountains,
The Lord loves the gates [1] of Zionmore than any dwelling in Jacob.
Glorious things are said of you,O city of God!Selah
II Rahab and Babylon I countamong those who know me.See, Philistia and Tyre, with Ethiopia,"This one was born there."
t[2]And of Zion it will be said:"Each one was born in it." [AB]The Most High will establish it; [AC]
the Lord notes in the register of the peoples:"This one was born there." [AD]Selah
So singers and dancers:"All my springs are in you." [AE]
